module_summary: Synchronizing edge detector: serial_i passes a multi-stage tc_sync synchronizer, then a delay flop compares old and new values to emit rising/falling edge pulses.

anchors.name: serial_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous input signal fed into synchronizer

anchors.name: serial
anchors.why: Synchronized input from tc_sync, compared with delayed copy for edges

anchors.name: serial_q
anchors.why: One-cycle delay of synchronized signal for edge comparison; drives serial_o

anchors.name: r_edge_o
anchors.why: Rising-edge pulse: synchronized high and delayed low

anchors.name: f_edge_o
anchors.why: Falling-edge pulse: synchronized low and delayed high

groups.name: edge_detect
groups.description: Delay flop and XOR-style compare producing rising and falling edge pulses
